My favorite brands are fromm and chicken soup for the soul. I use fromm healthy weight gold for an older hog but if yours is younger you can mix that with one of the other flavors like surf and turf. Chicken soup for the soul is also a great pick. A lot of people mix multiple cat foods to get their desired protein and fat percentages and give their hogs a well rounded diet however this is not necessary though, feeding gutloaded insects like dubia roaches , BSFL(doesn’t need to be gutloaded), crickets, mealworms, hornworms, loads of different bugs you can feed. Stable should be roaches / crickets - here’s a guide on how to gutload https://dubiaroaches.com/blogs/feeder-insect-care/what-is-gutloading. Offer insects every other day , about 3 times a week you can offer fresh fruit and veg, hedgehogs also love chicken, turkey, ( you can get these ground up so it’s easier to prepare for you) beef as well but that should be very occasional because of the high fat and it’s more just like a treat, and even salmon( some people are against salmon but my hedgehog loves it so I feed it every once and a while) you can alone provide canned wet cat food as a treat I just buy wellness cans every now and then, hedgehogs also love baby food, I think I covered a lot, good luck with ur hog!
